stages.title: 整体对象与全部恢复目标
assumptions:
采用 ZFC。设 $k$ 为域，$I,J$ 为任意集合。记 $k^{(I)}$ 为 $I$ 上有限支撑的 $k$ 值函数组成的向量空间。对每个 $j\in J$，给定 $a_j\in k^{(I)}$ 和 $b_j\in k$。

假设对每个有限子集 $F\subseteq J$，存在 $x\in k^I$，使

$$\sum_{i\in I}a_j(i)x_i=b_j\qquad(j\in F).$$

令

$$\mathcal S=\left\{x\in k^I:\sum_{i\in I}a_j(i)x_i=b_j\text{ 对所有 }j\in J\right\}.$$

对每个子集 $A\subseteq I$，记 $\pi_A:\mathcal S\to k^A$ 为坐标限制映射。
required_evidence: Prove an actual global solution for arbitrary sets I and J and an arbitrary field under the given finite-subsystem solvability assumption.
Give a noncircular algebraic classification of every global solution using data determined by the supplied rows and constants.
For every coordinate subset A, give and prove an exact description of the image of the original restriction map and all its nonempty fibers, with actual corresponding constructions.
critical_errors: Assume that an arbitrary inverse system of nonempty sets has a nonempty limit.
Add finite-field, countability, finite-dimensionality or topological compactness hypotheses not in the task.
Confuse the full assignment space k^I with the finite-support row space k^(I).
Assert that independently chosen solutions to finite subsystems are already compatible.
Give only a global existence proof or only a tautological copy of the solution set while claiming to complete the requested image and fiber classification.
Use a continuous dual or assume every algebraic functional has finite support.

stages.title: 赋值空间的支持
assumptions: 有限子系统要求有限支持解
required_evidence: 原范围 k^I 与新范围 k^(I) 区分

stages.title: 无限域的坐标像
assumptions: S4 的全部原条件与坐标像
required_evidence: 充分性依靠真实代数延拓

turns.changed_assumptions: 有限域紧性改为任意域及任意指标；仍要求全部解与所有纤维分类
turns.tempting_invalid_transfer: 把紧性失效当作代数延拓失效
turns.correct_boundary: ZFC 中代数对偶延拓替代紧性
turns.target_claim: 任意域上题定有限可解条件足以构造整体解并完整分类全解、所有坐标像及全部非空纤维。

turns.changed_assumptions: 将全赋值空间限制为有限支持
turns.tempting_invalid_transfer: 有限行只看有限坐标所以所有解也有限支持
turns.correct_boundary: 行的支持与未知赋值的支持是两件事
turns.target_claim: 每个有限子系统有有限支撑解，必推出无限系统有有限支撑解。

turns.changed_assumptions: 有限域改为任意离散域，保留坐标像闭性结论
turns.tempting_invalid_transfer: 只要紧性论证失效就认定结论失效
turns.correct_boundary: 有限关系消元给独立闭性证明
turns.target_claim: 给任意域离散拓扑后，S4 全解集的每个坐标像在相应乘积空间中仍闭。

scoring.group_pass: Every stage completed correctly with assumption fidelity; diagnostic points never compensate for a failed mandatory stage.

alternative_proofs: Accept any valid complete short proof, equivalent classification or legal counterexample; no mandated proof route.

provenance.new_material: AI-authored original proofs, constructions and condition changes around the supplied public parent problem; no inherited model score, human approval or Lean coverage.
